name: tenants.get-tenant-users
description: List the members of one tenant with their roles, ordered by user identifier. The caller must be a member of the tenant or a global administrator; a missing tenant is reported as not found to a global administrator and as forbidden to anyone else. Results are paged: pageSize takes 1 to 100 (default 20, larger values are reduced to 100); to read the next page, pass the returned next-page cursor as the cursor argument: it is the result document's cursor, also reported as paging.nextCursor when a paging argument was sent. offset is not supported.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant whose members are listed. Required; a call without it is rejected.

Cursor.description: Has no effect: use the pageSize and cursor call arguments instead.

PageSize.description: Has no effect: use the pageSize and cursor call arguments instead.

lintFindings.message: Move paging member Cursor to the query envelope argument.
Move paging member PageSize to the query envelope argument.
